title: Internal documents: Amazon is working on an Alexa project, codenamed Moonraker, to handle more complex, multistep tasks, projecting $100M+ in GPU costs in 2026 (Eugene Kim/Business Insider)
summary: Eugene Kim / Business Insider: Internal documents: Amazon is working on an Alexa project, codenamed Moonraker, to handle more complex, multistep tasks, projecting $100M+ in GPU costs in 2026 — Amazon's next Alexa AI upgrade may be able to handle more complex tasks. Getting there is expensive, though.
